if: Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; suppositive used to introduce a condition that may be (or prove to be) either true or false.
iff: Abbreviation of if and only if.
iffier: comparative form of iffy: more iffy
iffiest: superlative form of iffy: most iffy
iffiness: The state or quality of being iffy.
iffy: Of dubious authenticity, legitimacy or legality.
